message.content:
Absolutely! Those numbers are the exact latitude/longitude pair for the **Googleplex** (Google’s headquarters) in Mountain View, California.

If you’d like to confirm this yourself or retrieve additional information (e.g., formatted address, place ID, etc.) you can hit the Google Maps Geocoding API directly:

```http
GET https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json
    ?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499
    &key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your own key.  
A typical response will look something like this (truncated for brevity):

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "address_components": [...],
      "formatted_address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA",
      "geometry": {
        "location": { "lat": 37.4224764, "lng": -122.0842499 },
        ...
      },
      "place_id": "ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4J7x5Z1Y2w8",
      ...
    }
  ],
  "status": "OK"
}
```

From there you can pull out whatever fields you need—`formatted_address`, `place_id`, `types`, etc.—and use them in your application.
